First, we install the pak library

```{r}
install.packages("pak")
```

Then, we try to install the packages suggested in the index doc


```{r}
pak::pkg_install("broom")
pak::pkg_install("cytoMEM")
#pak::pkg_install("DillonHammill/CytoExploreR")
```

First to packages (from R and Bioconductor, respectively) are fine. However, the third one gives an error because pak is unable to install a dependency (superheat >= 1.0.0).

```{r}
pak::pkg_install("superheat")
```

When we install it manually, the last version is 0.1.0. Now, we try to install it using install_github()

```{r}
install_github("DillonHammill/CytoExploreR")
```

This time, it works!
